elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph applies “[u]pon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason.”
IBM must provide transition assistance only “at Customer’s request,” adding a condition not present in the preferred position.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.

elements.evidence: The return duty applies only “within thirty (30) days of Customer’s request,” so IBM has no unconditional duty to return the data following expiry or termination. The operative data term is “Content.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return in a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the requested standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The deadline runs from “Customer’s request,” not from expiry or termination; a later request permits return more than 30 days after exit.

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires IBM to “thereafter delete Content from its systems,” referring to the return required by subsection (b).

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion after deleting Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires IBM to “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: The obligations apply upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The added paragraph is triggered by expiry or termination of the Agreement or any Service Option Attachment.
The assistance duty is conditioned on Customer making a request, whereas the fallback states the assistance requirement without that condition.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: An assistance window of up to six months exceeds the fallback 90-day window.
IBM must return Content only following Customer’s request, so the clause does not impose an automatic post-exit export duty.

elements.element: Customer Data is exported within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period begins on Customer’s request rather than on expiry or termination.

result.reason: Neither level is fully satisfied because the operative language conditions assistance and data return on Customer requests and measures the data-return deadline from the request rather than from expiry or termination. The margin comment cannot cure those operative limitations. The amendment is also overbroad: termination of any single Service Option Attachment triggers return and deletion of all Content, potentially disrupting unaffected attachments and conflicting with the preceding sentence preserving obligations under other attachments.
